svg.title: No collisions
svg.desc: Nodes look at the live graph before asking; Lead times borrows running work; a race between two identical new questions folds into one.

text.tspan: Every question is registered the moment it's asked, so work in flight is visible to everyone.
Lead times needs transformer data. It looks first, finds Transformers running, and borrows it.
Two nodes ask the same new question at the same moment. Both register, so both briefly exist.
On its next look, Grid's copy finds the other one. Grid joins it, and the copy closes.
The race cost seconds of duplicate work, not a wrong answer.
The live graph is the claims board.
